content.caption: A small reading lamp stands on its dark base in the grass, its pale shade catching the last of the light, with a wooden pergola stretching overhead. Beyond it sit a brown building with a red roof, a green tree, and the sea glinting along the edge of the island.
content.opinion: The lamp is mine, and it is still the best thing in the frame, even if it is standing in the grass rather than on a desk where it belongs.
